newsitem.title: USA: Reading & Bates has potential producer.
newsitem.headline: Reading & Bates has potential producer.

text.p: Reading & Bates Corp said the well drilled on its East Breaks 688 "East Boomvang" prospect in the U.S. Gulf of Mexico has been suspended as a potential producer.
The well was successfully drilled to a total depth of 10,833 feet measured depth, plugged back and sidetracked to 10,350 feet for geological reasons, Reading & Bates said.
The sidetrack encountered about 220 net feet of hydrocarbon pay in the target sands. The wellbore was logged and fluid samples and cores obtained.
The company said it is evaluating the data gathered and is conducting engineering and technical work on a preliminary development plan for the prospect.

Reading & Bates said it now intends to proceed with additional drilling in the prospect area under terms of a joint venture agreement with the Royal Dutch/Shell Group's Shell Deepwater Development Inc.
This prospect area consists of an eight block area contiguous to "East Boomvang" and includes the "North Boomvang" and "East Bequia" prospects.

Chief executive Paul B. Loyd Jr. stated, "We are pleased to have encountered potentially commercial amounts of hydrocarbons in the 'East Boomvang' well, and we are hopeful that the additional prospects within the area could enhance the 'East Boomvang' discovery."
